mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Career Development Plan' (transferable skills component) and 'Career perspectives and employability'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept directly addresses increased research and transferable skills for the fellow: the Career Development Plan enumerates seven transferable-skill strands (research integrity; open science and FAIR practice; generative-AI literacy; grant writing; IP and exploitation; project management; science communication), and the 'Career perspectives and employability' section states the fellowship will provide advanced competence in Bayesian/probabilistic modelling, uncertainty quantification, spatio-temporal validation, sensor-domain transfer, cross-country adaptation, operational AI evaluation, research-to-MVP translation and IP/exploitation, with a stated intended progression (Plant Physiologist/Agronomist -> EO/Geospatial Crop Scientist -> independent researcher) relevant to employability within academia and beyond.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' and 'Non-academic placement'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept forges new mind-sets through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience: international mobility Hungary->Bulgaria (MATE-MVCRI cross-country transfer); inter-sectoral exposure via the six-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR; and genuine interdisciplinary two-way transfer between crop physiology/agronomy and geospatial/data science documented in the supervision and two-way-transfer sections.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: The concept enhances networking and communication with peers and the public: scientific dissemination targets four principal outputs (P1-P4) with at least two peer-reviewed submissions, and public engagement beyond peers is committed via one public field demonstration with AgroVIR farmers and one public-facing article per year, with science communication named as a transferable-skill strand.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly addresses alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers, evidenced at instrument level by the Career Development Plan (D1.3), by ELTE's open recruitment and researcher-development policies, and by the documented supervision and training arrangements. The term 'European Charter for Researchers' appears verbatim.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision cadence and governance' and 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept enhances quality and sustainability of research training and supervision through a defined supervision cadence (weekly one-to-one, weekly technical sessions with the co-supervisor through WP3-WP4, monthly progress record, quarterly CDP reviews), a Project Steering Group with go/no-go verdicts at M6/M12/M16/M20, and explicit decision-rights and conflict-resolution structures.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: The concept addresses increased attractiveness, visibility and reputation of the participating organisation via the 'Host capacity, attractiveness and visibility' section (ELTE Faculty of Informatics remote-sensing group, hyperspectral and UAV instrumentation, HPC, international network participation including COST Actions). Coverage is present but thin: five host-capacity fields are declared Unresolved in the brief pending organisational input.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept strengthens R&I capacity and knowledge transfer among participating organisations through documented bidirectional transfer (Fellow->ELTE brings plant physiology, horticultural crop science, water-stress experimentation and hyperspectral field measurements; ELTE->Fellow brings geoinformatics, EO time-series, Bayesian modelling), producing an academic-research-industry knowledge chain across MATE, MVCRI and AgroVIR.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: The concept provides regular feedback of research results into teaching and education through three concrete measures: co-designing and delivering a full module unit within an ELTE MSc course on Earth observation for agriculture, primary-supervising one ELTE MSc thesis, and co-supervising the field-experiment component of one PhD student's work.
